title: Design System: The Ranch STEAM Lab

display.purpose: Hero headline only, one phrase per line.

title.purpose: Monitor reading names and the wordmark.

lead.purpose: Product pitches, About copy, hero intro.

status.purpose: Monitor status lines in Monitor Haze.

shadows.name: panel-tracking
shadows.purpose: Product image frame while the cursor tracks it.

shadows.name: lamp-live
shadows.purpose: Resting glow of the live lamp.

shadows.name: glint-glow
shadows.purpose: Filter glow on the travelling frame glint.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: All state, tilt and reveal transitions.

motion.name: panel-settle
motion.purpose: Panel returns flat after the pointer leaves.

motion.name: panel-track
motion.purpose: Panel follows the pointer while tracking (max ±5deg Y, ±4deg X, perspective 1000px).

motion.name: sheen-fade
motion.purpose: Pointer sheen fades in and out.

motion.name: glint-orbit
motion.purpose: Sun glint travelling around each panel frame.

motion.name: product-reveal
motion.value: 900ms ease-out, clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) and translateY(24px) to open
motion.purpose: One-time reveal of each product image on entering the viewport (rootMargin -15% bottom).

motion.name: live-lamp-pulse
motion.purpose: Live lamp on the monitor reads as generating.

motion.name: field-sun-follow
motion.value: lerp 0.06 per frame; idle drift period about 90s
motion.purpose: Hero sun eases toward the pointer, drifts when idle.

motion.name: field-wake-sweep
motion.value: 14ms per column stagger, 700ms cubic ease-out; RSL flash at +650ms
motion.purpose: Load sweep from flat to tracking, left to right.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Field draws one still frame and redraws only on pointer; glint parks at 140deg; tilt, reveal, pulse and smooth scroll off.

components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;min-height:48px;padding:.8rem 1.4rem;background:var(--monitor,#0B1E3F);color:var(--monitor-ink,#E6F2FC);font-family: var(--font-body, 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif);font-weight:600;font-size:1.0625rem;text-decoration:none;border-radius:0;transition:background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-btn::after{content:"";width:.55em;height:.55em;border-top:2px solid currentColor;border-right:2px solid currentColor;transform:rotate(135deg);margin-top:-.25em;margin-left:.1rem}.ds-btn:hover{background:var(--cell,#1F4E9C)}.ds-btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#0E2A5C);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:2px}@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){.ds-btn{background:#2E64C2;color:#fff}.ds-btn:hover{background:#3D74D4}}

components.css: .ds-monitor{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0 24px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));background:var(--monitor,#0B1E3F);color:var(--monitor-ink,#E6F2FC);font-family: var(--font-body, 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif);}.ds-reading{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;grid-template-areas:"lamp name" ". status" ". link";column-gap:.75rem;row-gap:.15rem;align-content:start;padding:1.1rem 1.25rem 1.25rem;border-left:1px solid rgba(157,185,220,.25)}.ds-reading:first-child{border-left:0;padding-left:0}.ds-lamp{grid-area:lamp;align-self:center;display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%}.ds-reading[data-state=live] .ds-lamp{background:#FFC93C;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(255,201,60,.22)}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-reading[data-state=live] .ds-lamp{animation:ds-generating 2.4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) infinite}}@keyframes ds-generating{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,201,60,.5)}70%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(255,201,60,0)}}.ds-reading[data-state=wait] .ds-lamp{background:conic-gradient(currentColor 0 50%,transparent 0);border:2px solid currentColor}.ds-reading[data-state=dev] .ds-lamp{border:2px dashed currentColor}.ds-rname{grid-area:name;font-family: var(--font-display, 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif);font-weight:800;font-size:1.25rem;letter-spacing:-.01em}.ds-rstatus{grid-area:status;color:var(--monitor-soft,#9DB9DC);font-size:.95rem}.ds-rlink{grid-area:link;justify-self:start;font-weight:600;color:var(--monitor-ink,#E6F2FC);text-decoration-color:var(--monitor-soft,#9DB9DC);text-underline-offset:.22em;margin-top:.35rem}.ds-rlink:hover{text-decoration-color:currentColor;text-decoration-thickness:2px}.ds-rlink:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--monitor-ink,#E6F2FC);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:2px}

components.name: Panel Frame
components.description: Product image as a solar panel: 8px frame, travelling glint, tilt toward the cursor (tilt is scripted; hover here shows the tracking shadow and sheen).
components.css: @property --ds-glint{syntax:"<angle>";inherits:false;initial-value:0deg}.ds-pband{background:#163A72;padding:40px}.ds-panel{position:relative;display:block;max-width:360px;padding:8px;background:color-mix(in srgb,#163A72 70%,#000);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(188,211,240,.28),0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.05),0 28px 56px -18px rgba(3,10,28,.7);transition:transform 600ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow 600ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-glass{display:block;aspect-ratio:1.9;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#081733,#2E64C2 60%,#E6F2FC)}.ds-panel::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;padding:8px;background:conic-gradient(from var(--ds-glint),transparent 0deg 250deg,rgba(142,193,255,.55) 300deg,#fff 330deg,rgba(255,201,60,.9) 338deg,rgba(142,193,255,.4) 350deg,transparent 360deg);-webkit-mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,linear-gradient(#000 0 0);-webkit-mask-composite:xor;mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box exclude,linear-gradient(#000 0 0);animation:ds-orbit 7s linear infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(142,193,255,.9));pointer-events:none}@keyframes ds-orbit{to{--ds-glint:360deg}}.ds-sheen{position:absolute;inset:8px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 60% 30%,rgba(230,242,252,.35),rgba(230,242,252,0) 45%);mix-blend-mode:screen;opacity:0;transition:opacity 400ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);pointer-events:none}.ds-panel:hover{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(188,211,240,.45),0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.05),0 40px 70px -20px rgba(3,10,28,.8)}.ds-panel:hover .ds-sheen{opacity:1}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-panel::before{animation:none;--ds-glint:140deg}}

narrative.overview:
The lab is Babcock Ranch's solar field seen from the air under a bright Florida sky. Everything is a panel: rectangular, square-cornered, set in rows, shaded by where the sun is. The page reads top to bottom as sky, horizon, array and inverter monitor, then a run of deep-blue product bands, then sky again for the facts. The cursor is the sun. The hero panels follow it, the panels that spell RSL throw white glints, and each product image sits in a panel frame that tilts toward the pointer.

Density is calm and generous. Large heavy display type sits on open sky, and status reads in a plain monitor voice ("Live on iPhone and web", "In development", "Waitlist, launching early 2027"). There is one palette family. The whole site lives in sky and photovoltaic blues, and products are told apart by name, pitch and image, never by their own colours. The only warm colour is sunlight.

Motion is slow, eased and physical: panels track, glints travel, rows reveal once. Nothing bounces, and nothing animates for decoration alone. When the visitor asks for reduced motion, the field renders one still frame and every loop stops.
keyCharacteristics: Sky, field and navy-monitor bands stacked like an aerial view.
Square-cornered panels everywhere; the only round shapes are the sun and the status lamps, plus Ripple Pool's round board image.
One family of blues; sun yellow appears only as light.
Heavy Bricolage Grotesque display set tight against a plain Hanken Grotesk body.
Status shown by lamp shape as well as colour: a solid pulsing sun for live, half-filled for waitlist, dashed for in development.

rules.name: The Sunlight Only Rule
rules.body: Yellow is light, never paint. It appears only where the sun would: the sun, the live lamp, the glint core, selection, the skip link and the dark-mode focus ring. It never fills a surface, a button or a heading.

rules.name: The One Sky Rule
rules.body: Every product is shown in the lab's blues: band backgrounds, inks, buttons and duotoned images. A product's own brand colour never appears on this site.

rules.name: The Plain Voice Rule
rules.body: Status and labels are set in sentence case in the body face. There are no uppercase tracked labels and no small lines above headings. The display face is only for names and titles.

rules.name: The Only Panels Lift Rule
rules.body: Only framed product images cast drop shadows. Bands, buttons, the monitor and the facts table stay flat; the sun halo and lamp glows are light, not lift.

dos: Do build new surfaces from square panels in rows, with corners at `rounded.none`.
Do keep every product in the lab's blues and duotone its imagery to #081733 / #2E64C2 / #E6F2FC before shipping.
Do show status with lamp shape plus plain words (live, waitlist, in development), never with colour alone.
Do give each dark band its own `--focus` colour so the 3px focus ring stays visible.
Do gate every loop and tilt behind `prefers-reduced-motion` and leave a still, complete state.
Do use `ease-out` (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for all state and reveal transitions.
donts: Don't use sun yellow as a surface, button or text colour; it is light only.
Don't round cards, buttons or bands. The sun, the lamps and the Ripple Pool board are the only circles.
Don't introduce a product's own brand colours on this site.
Don't add drop shadows to anything except framed product images; the sun halo and lamp glows are light, not elevation.
Don't add uppercase tracked labels or small lines above headings; status speaks in sentence case.
Don't add animation beyond the field, the glint, the tilt, the one-time reveal and the live-lamp pulse.
